title: GUN KEY AND WHEEL NAMES FIT
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: at the default menu size on a 1440p or 4K screen, and at 1920x1080 fullscreen, the GUN KEYS and ITEM WHEEL tiles on the stash cut their names off mid word (MARKSMAN 58 px of text in 35, CARBINE 45 in 35, SHOTGUN, PISTOL, SNIPER, ENERGY, BANDAGE, ARMOUR, TRIPWIRE). Proven in headless Chromium at 1920x1080 with the menu zoom 1.3 (the same layout as 2560x1440). The tile names drop to 12px with no letter spacing, the two plates sit 10px apart instead of 22, the tile insides are a little tighter, and the gun plate takes a touch more of the row; every name now shows whole with a few pixels to spare and the gun picture never touches its name.
now: Every gun key and item wheel name on the stash now shows in full at 1440p and 4K.

edits.replacement: #kitsetup .ksrow{ display:flex; gap:10px; padding:2px 12px 4px; }   /* v16.xx (cloud-menus-kit-tile-names-fit), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: the names were cut at the default menu size from 1080p fullscreen up; the plates sit closer */

edits.anchor: #kitsetup .ksp:first-child{ flex:1.1 1 0; }   /* v26.xx (gunkeys3): the nine class names (MARKSMAN) need a little more room than the wheel names (TRIPWIRE) */
edits.replacement: #kitsetup .ksp:first-child{ flex:1.2 1 0; }   /* v26.xx (gunkeys3): the nine class names (MARKSMAN) need a little more room than the wheel names (TRIPWIRE) */   /* v16.xx (cloud-menus-kit-tile-names-fit), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: 1.2 leaves MARKSMAN and TRIPWIRE the same spare room */

edits.anchor: #kitsetup .kst span{ min-width:0; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; font-weight:700; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--tx-1); text-transform:uppercase; }
edits.replacement: #kitsetup .kst span{ min-width:0; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; font-weight:700; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:0; color:var(--tx-1); text-transform:uppercase; }   /* v16.xx (cloud-menus-kit-tile-names-fit), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: 13px spaced did not fit MARKSMAN */
#kitsetup .kst{ gap:4px; padding:0 3px; }   /* v16.xx (cloud-menus-kit-tile-names-fit), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: 4px still keeps the enlarged gun picture off its name */
